title: The Rivergate of Patagonia's dry side
author: August Galloway
blurb: Noor Thornbury, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the concession permits expire.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
